results.fact: ice_grade 'M1' vs beta's description of 'vertical mixed terrain'
results.correct_value: M1 steep snow/rime; the winter ascent stayed on steep snow and rime and avoided the harder mixed direct gully
results.evidence: The published route listing grades the West Face 'M1 Steep Snow' and describes all five pitches as steep snow/gully climbing. The first winter ascent account (Feb 10, 2024) describes steep, increasingly icy snow full of rime, gear found by clearing rime from rock, and says the steep direct gully looked like tough mixed climbing so they stuck to snow; nothing describes vertical mixed ground. The row's overview, approach_variants notes and ice_grade all agree with steep snow; beta's 'vertical mixed terrain' is the outlier. Both external pages likely come from the same party, so they are counted as one.
